name: telecom-x-churn-analysis
description: AI-Powered Customer Churn Analysis Platform - Enterprise Solution
author: Elizabeth Díaz Familia <lizzyfamilia@gmail.com>

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:frontend -- --coverage && npm run test:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && flake8 app/ && mypy app/
scripts.format: npm run format:frontend && npm run format:backend
scripts.format:backend: cd backend && black app/ && isort app/
scripts.clean: rm -rf frontend/dist frontend/node_modules backend/__pycache__ backend/.pytest_cache backend/htmlcov
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && rm -rf node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/venv
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.deploy:frontend: cd frontend && npm run build && vercel --prod
